mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, labor market tightness drives wage inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing Industrial Production (INDPRO) and Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a supply-side boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly increase in Retail Sales (RSAFS) indicates surging consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during holiday seasons (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 30% of holiday seasons with RSAFS growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signal monetary tightening, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances with consecutive FEDFUNDS hikes.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between decreasing Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) and increasing Payroll Employment (PAYEMS) signals a labor market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1% quarterly decrease in GDP (GDPC1) indicates slowing economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during recessions (as indicated by NBER).
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 40% of recessionary quarters with GDPC1 decline > 1%.
